mappings.rationale: The covered entity must let individuals request restrictions on uses and disclosures and accommodate reasonable confidential-communication requests; PRI-05.4 restricts processing to what the data subject has authorised, which is the mechanism that gives effect to an agreed restriction, and PRI-06.4 is the process for receiving and responding to such subject requests — the mandatory out-of-pocket restriction is a HIPAA-specific rule with no SCF analogue.

Breaches of unsecured PHI must be notified to individuals, HHS and sometimes media within 60 days with prescribed content, and business associates must notify the covered entity; IRO-04.1 addresses data breaches according to applicable law, IRO-10 delivers the timely reporting to affected clients and regulatory authorities, and IRO-10.2 is the timely reporting of incidents involving sensitive or regulated data.
